_meta.description: Bank of China published personal tariff items relevant to moving money out of China. These are the institution's own official prices, not estimates. FX SPREAD is deliberately absent: no official spread figure was verified, so it is null and flagged.
_meta.warning: Today is 2026-11-08. Item 210108014 changes in three days, on 2026-11-11. Both the current and the incoming figure are shown.

fees.service: Cross-border outward remittance by telegraphic transfer or bank draft (境外汇款／电汇、票汇)
fees.notes: Charged on top of the cable/telecommunication charge (B02) and, if used, the full-value-arrival surcharge (B03).

fees.service: Cable / telecommunication charge (电讯费) on a cross-border remittance
fees.amount_text: RMB 80 for Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan; RMB 150 for other international destinations
fees.notes: This is the single largest fixed cost on a small remittance to the US.

fees.service: Guaranteed full-value arrival / OUR charges (全额到账)
fees.amount_text: USD 15 if the beneficiary bank holds its account at Bank of China New York; otherwise USD 25. EUR 25 for amounts up to EUR 1 million. AUD up to 15. Other currencies up to EUR 50 equivalent.
fees.notes: Only charged where an intermediary bank is needed, and is additional to B01 and B02. Without it, correspondent banks deduct their own fees from the principal.

fees.service: Overseas bank charges on an outward remittance
fees.notes: The amount is set by the foreign correspondent and beneficiary banks and is not published by Bank of China, so no figure can be given. This is a real, unquantified cost layer.

fees.service: Foreign exchange conversion at a Bank of China branch (个人结售汇)
fees.charge: NO separate conversion fee at Bank of China's own branches
fees.amount_text: Branch counter: free. Self-service machines: up to RMB 60. Agent exchange outlets: up to 0.1%.
fees.notes: Critical: 'no fee' does NOT mean 'no cost'. The bank still earns the bid-ask spread between its quoted rate and the interbank rate. That spread is the real conversion penalty and is not published as a fee.

fees.service: Foreign currency carrying permit (外币携带证)
fees.amount_text: Listed at RMB 10 but waived from 2025-04-01 to 2026-12-31
fees.notes: Tariff note 11 states temporary waivers lapse when the next tariff takes effect, so confirm the waiver is still running before relying on it.

fees.service: Deposit certificate (存款证明) and credit certificate (资信证明)
fees.amount_text: Deposit certificate RMB 20 to 40; credit certificate up to RMB 100
fees.notes: Relevant because SAFE property-transfer applications and above-quota purchases often require proof-of-funds certificates.

fees.service: Cross-border ATM cash withdrawal — Great Wall debit card (current tariff)
fees.notes: SUPERSEDED on 2026-11-11 by B09/B10. Great Wall International Debit Card currently: 0.5% of the withdrawal, min USD 3, max USD 5 per transaction.

fees.service: Overseas / HK-Macao-Taiwan ATM withdrawal — UnionPay network (FROM 2026-11-11)
fees.notes: Unchanged from the current tariff. Verified in the bank's own change announcement.

fees.service: Overseas / HK-Macao-Taiwan ATM withdrawal — Mastercard and VISA networks (FROM 2026-11-11)
fees.notes: NEW and materially worse for large withdrawals: the cap rises from USD 5 to USD 40 equivalent and the rate from 0.5% to 2.5%. Practical consequence: after 2026-11-11 use a UnionPay card, not Mastercard or VISA, for overseas cash.

fees.service: Clean collection of a foreign-currency instrument (光票托收)
fees.notes: Plus actual postage. RMB 10 return fee if the overseas bank returns the item.

fees.service: Amending or refunding an outward remittance
fees.amount_text: Amendment up to RMB 50; refund RMB 20, plus the cable charge
fees.notes: Getting beneficiary details wrong is not free.

fees.service: FX bid-ask spread actually applied to a personal CNY/USD conversion (the real conversion penalty)
fees.notes: UNVERIFIED — left blank deliberately. Bank of China publishes daily quoted rates but no official document stating the spread it applies to personal conversions was located. Commonly quoted figures of roughly 0.24%-0.3% appear only on secondary sites and are therefore NOT used. To measure it yourself, compare the bank's contemporaneous USD cash-buying and cash-selling quotes against the CFETS central parity rate on the same day.
